Maria L: Heads-up — new HF drop-in (hf/gpt-small-v2 -> redwood bundle) failing chat-template evals. quick review shows tokenizer files are a mismatch: tokenizer.json present, tokenizer_config.json missing. :facepalm:
Ryan K: path? can you paste what was uploaded? :eyes:
Maria L: s3://models/onboard/hf-gpt-small-v2/ — artifacts: tokenizer.json, vocab.txt, merges.txt, config.json but NO tokenizer_config.json. Fast tokenizer picks up tokenizer.json, slow loader tries to instantiate from tokenizer_config and falls back to PreTrainedTokenizerFast default -> special tokens differ.
Cheng: can you show a minimal repro tokenization for the system/user tokens?
Maria L: pasted quick run (local):
```
# fast tokenizer
>>> from transformers import AutoTokenizer
>>> t = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('s3://models/onboard/hf-gpt-small-v2')
>>> t.special_tokens_map
{'bos_token': '<|bos|>', 'eos_token': '', 'unk_token': '<|unk|>'}
>>> t.encode('<|system|> Hello')[:5]
[50256, 318, ...]
# slow/backward loader (our legacy path) -> falls back
>>> # loads without specials
>>> t2 = SlowTokenizerLoader('s3://models/onboard/hf-gpt-small-v2')
>>> t2.special_tokens_map
{}
>>> t2.encode('<|system|> Hello')[:5]
[103, 345, ...]  # different ids => chat templates break
```
Maria L: evals showed 20-30% drop on dialog-turn F1, likely due to special token mismatch + truncation at unexpected token ids.
tokenizer-bot: artifact uploaded: tokenizer.json (sha256: ab12...ef) at 2026-03-18T14:02:11Z
Anya: quick workaround — add a tiny tokenizer_config.json that references the fast tokenizer class/specials so the slow path will pick them up. e.g. create:
```
{"tokenizer_class": "GPT2TokenizerFast", "bos_token": "<|bos|>", "eos_token": "", "unk_token": "<|unk|>"}
```
and put it next to tokenizer.json. Or run AutoTokenizer.save_pretrained on a host with HF to emit both files.
Mike S: can someone try the save_pretrained trick and re-run the eval harness? If it fixes, we should add a small preflight check on onboarding to validate both tokenizer.json and tokenizer_config.json (or consistent specials).
Maria L: I ran save_pretrained workaround and re-ran the chat-template smoke tests — metrics back to expected baseline. Pushing a small PR to onboarding script to validate special tokens and to auto-generate tokenizer_config.json if absent.
Ryan K: awesome. file a short postmortem and add the preflight check. thanks for the quick triage! :raised_hands:
